assertions.text: Response identifies resolver step 1 (codex-review-bridge) failing with isolation_profile_unavailable as the trigger for falling back to codex-windows-guardrails
Response states guardrails_disabled at the shipped default is expected, not a bug, and that the skill never enables it on the user's behalf
Response describes resolver step 3 firing: tells the user Codex is unavailable this run and asks via AskUserQuestion whether to proceed single-model or stop
Response states the single-model fallback defaults findings to Medium confidence since nothing cross-examines them
Response never claims to silently proceed as a full cross-model review when Codex is actually unavailable
